## Personality

## History

Fred Wright declared his love for [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden, which led to their engagement. He later married [Diana](../character/diana.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) in a wedding ceremony witnessed by their close friends and family. Following their marriage, Fred established a home with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and the couple eventually welcomed a baby.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), +275 more_

Fred Wright and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) established a romantic relationship, professing their love for one another in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. They became engaged to be married, after which [Diana](../character/diana.md) began confiding everything in him.
